name: Kickin' Hawk
abilities: Master hand-to-hand (and foot-to-head) fighter - Ben's best close-range brawler
Sharp, extendable talons on his arms and clawed hands and feet
Powerful kicks (sent Fistrick across a room; hurt Kevin's metal form)
Enhanced strength and durability (withstood a heavy metal mallet)
Enhanced jumping - extreme height and distance
Enhanced speed and agility (runs fast enough to leave a dust trail)
Limited space survivability - can withstand vacuum while holding his breath
weaknesses: Collapses and falls asleep if his neck is rubbed
Still needs to breathe - no oxygen supply means holding his breath in space
summary: A brown-feathered rooster-hawk brawler in a green mask and harness whose spinning kicks and arm talons make him Ben's go-to martial artist.
traits: Screeches like a red-tailed hawk when he talks or kicks
Same species as Liam, but Liam is not the DNA donor
Working names included Ka-Chickin, Chi-Kickin and KiChicken
Mask resembles Hawkman; outfit resembles 1980s Marvel Hercules
Spinning kick resembles Street Fighter's Tatsumaki Senpukyaku
notableFeats: Beat Fistrick and his Muroid army (Bros in Space)
Kicked the Vreedle Brothers' TNT away before it exploded (O Mother, Where Art Thou?)
Fought Kevin to cover his team's escape from Rooter HQ (Weapon XI: Part 1)
Tricked and defeated Charmcaster with Skurd's help, kicking her into her own bag (Third Time's a Charm)
Escaped the Null Void with the game-show contestants (The Most Dangerous Game Show)

appearances.designNotes: Brown feathers with white-brown mohawk and belly, short yellow beak, green eyes, black claws, two large talons jutting from the forearms, green mask, green strap vest and green/white belt, black briefs; Omnitrix symbol on the vest hook.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (469x738, transparent). Note the file name spells 'Kicken'.

scoring.rationale: A pure martial artist: kicks that launch Fistrick and dent metal Kevin, mallet-proof toughness, big leaps and dust-trail speed. No ranged, energy or special abilities, and he lost to Kevin, Kundo and the Krakken; electricity, a neck rub or bird seed can take him out.

notes: Unlocked in Outbreak when the malfunctioning Omnitrix 'sampled' Liam; the wiki notes Liam cannot be the true DNA donor because the DNA was already catalogued.
Alternate spelling 'Kickin Hawk' in some credits and on Bandai packaging.
Albedo cannot transform into Kickin' Hawk (Derrick J. Wyatt).
Games (Wrath of Psychobos, Cavern Run, Slammers) and comics not counted.
